candidate_findings.status: Source-supported conditional cross-field contract question; central disposition/alias/count and product policy remain open.
candidate_findings.condition: Otherwise valid enclosing Burgonet with BuffeDesign default values, Some(default three-course BuffeCourses), Some(VisorBreaths::buffe() with height=950), nonzero count and successful recipe kernel construction. The individual course and breath predicates accept these fields. Editor code passes 50..=950 to a number control and constructs default courses and breaths independently; control implementation, UI behavior and persistence were not exercised.
candidate_findings.mathematical_reasoning: Default upper boundary 700 per mille and overlap 5 mm give top-course height 100*(1 - 0.700)+5 ≈35 mm. Breath height 950 per mille produces center 95 mm in the 100 mm full-face chart; width 3 mm, length 12 mm, inclination 0 leave vertices around y=89–101 mm, outside 0–35 mm. Slot spacing passes: required span 4*3+3*3=21 <=54, opposite-side gap 2*36-54=18 >=3, one row. PiercedDomain tests hole vertices against the outer rectangle and returns typed VisorOpeningSpacing before triangulation. This is source arithmetic, not a simulated fixture or runtime observation.
candidate_findings.impact: A design whose separate child predicates pass may later fail geometry admission. Whether this is a defect depends on the intended contract and whether the caller exposes the typed error; no accepted malformed mesh, product outage, actual interaction, or silent failure is claimed.
candidate_findings.future_direction: Resolve whether the height is relative to the full face or top course and whether this state should be prevented at the owning design/editor boundary or represented as an explicit fallible geometry outcome. Retain valid zero-disabled patterns and the domain web/clearance check; do not presuppose UI or visual behavior.
candidate_findings.historical_alias_qualification: Related to historical rig CONTRACT-591 and INITIAL06-GROUP-022; neither bounded record explicitly proves this numerical combination. Search was bounded and cannot establish global novelty; central decides aliases and count.

nonfindings: For zero count other scalar controls are still validated, then spacing returns early and no openings are produced; it is a supported disabled setting, not itself an invalid state.
Validated count one uses a dedicated offset branch; zero rows cannot enter the row body. On validated courses, +180 follows lower range guard, so no overflow follows from that operation.
Upper seam remains range-checked for a two-course descriptor; alone this is not evidence that two-course mode is invalid.
Left/Right signs depend on the carrier coordinate convention; no anatomical reversal is established by sign alone.
Geometry rejects hole vertices outside the top course or within the 3 mm web before CDT; this observation does not claim a malformed mesh is built.
open_questions: Is design.validate intended to guarantee all deterministic geometric combinations, or is fallible geometry-level admission an accepted contract?
If this state is considered unsupported, is its typed error visible and actionable to the author, and where should course/slot relationship be owned?
What exact chart-frame convention and all supported carriers govern Left/Right?
What are the producer persistence, other geometry callers, device kernel failures, native triangulator guarantees, and actual UI interaction? These were not assessed.
Is the candidate already covered by another recovered queue/ledger contract outside the bounded searches? Central reconciliation decides.

lenses.name: producer-propagation
lenses.assessment: Current editor independently mutates optional courses and breaths; HelmetDesign validates then recipe dispatches through Burgonet to pierced domain. UI persistence/error presentation and other callers remain untraced.

lenses.name: existing-type-owners
lenses.assessment: Millimeters, Permille, SlotInclination and VentSides retain distinct units/closed alternatives. Public wrappers and raw fields do not by themselves ensure contextual slot-within-course constraints.

lenses.name: admission-contracts
lenses.assessment: VisorBreaths and BuffeCourses each enforce their own scalar/spacing relations. Parent calls them independently; sampled out-of-course combination is rejected later at the geometry domain. Whether parent admission must reject it remains open.

lenses.name: invariant-operations
lenses.assessment: The validated count-zero and count-one branches avoid count subtraction/division hazards; rows-zero yields no loop. Lower boundary is range-checked before +180 due to short-circuit. No arbitrary caller safety claimed.

lenses.name: aggregate-states
lenses.assessment: Breath extent depends on top course extent, overlap and pattern geometry; separately valid breath and course values can nevertheless yield out-of-course holes. The concrete conditional source-math witness is documented as candidate only.

lenses.name: type-ownership
lenses.assessment: VisorBreaths owns pattern and its unit/side distinctions; BuffeCourses owns seam/overlap, while pierced geometry checks the actual domain. Placement of a cross-field policy requires design decision, not automatic new generic type.

lenses.name: redundant-authority
lenses.assessment: Authored fraction and actual mm domain are different representations of placement; 100 mm face chart and shortened course height are related by geometry, not proven independent competing facts. Their compatibility requires explicit policy.

lenses.name: behavior-preservation
lenses.assessment: Two assigned historical source objects are byte-identical to 6533 and 95e individually; surrounding application changes, runtime behavior and full snapshot cleanliness are not established.

lenses.name: enum-shapes
lenses.assessment: Both/Left/Right preserve closed side alternatives and Option courses/breaths are supported modes. Zero count deliberately produces no openings; do not require arbitrary nonempty geometry.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.assessment: Assigned structures use ordinary derive and Serde. No manual trait replacement or serialization behavior change is established from these bounded files.

lenses.name: type-granularity
lenses.assessment: Degree SlotInclination differs from signed continuous radians; chart millimetres and Permille placement differ from count and course index. A single generic fraction or angle is not proven adequate.

lenses.name: magic-strings
lenses.assessment: No material business string-valued field or API in assigned sources. Error variants and enum choices are typed; broader UI labels or unrelated source families remain outside scope.

lenses.name: magic-numbers
lenses.assessment: Range limits, 3 mm web and 100 mm chart are concrete numeric contracts; top course physical height and chart height need joint interpretation. No arbitrary blanket wrapper or visual correctness claim follows.
